# Idea Scouting

## Scouting Objective

User goal: find low-compute evaluation ideas.

## Candidate Ideas

| ID | Candidate idea | Falsifiable hypothesis | Evaluation metric / baseline | Lightweight evidence | Novelty risk | Feasibility budget | User-goal fit | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A | stress-test small rerankers | reranker calibration fails under paraphrase shift | nDCG against BM25 baseline | local benchmark gaps observed | adjacent robustness work exists | one day CPU eval | matches thesis scope | recommend |

## Promotion Gate

- Falsifiable hypothesis: reranker calibration degrades under paraphrase shift.
- Evaluation metric / baseline / benchmark: nDCG versus BM25.
- Lightweight evidence: existing local benchmark gap.
- Novelty-risk note: adjacent robustness work must be checked.
- Feasibility budget: one day CPU evaluation.
- User-goal fit: high.
